name: Westside San Joaquin Valley near Los Banos
time_convention: index i = hour beginning Jan 1 00:00 PST + i h (fixed UTC-8, no DST); radiation uses Open-Meteo label i+1 (preceding-hour mean); temperature/wind = mean(label i, label i+1)
source: Open-Meteo historical weather archive, best_match model (ECMWF IFS ~9 km analysis for 2017+, ERA5 before)
solar_model: pvlib single-axis tracker (axis tilt 0, azimuth 180, +/-60 deg, backtracking, GCR 0.35), Hay-Davies, albedo 0.2, physical IAM, SAPM open-rack cell temp, PVWatts DC gamma -0.0037, losses 14%, DC/AC 1.2, inverter eff 0.96; CF per MW_ac
wind_model: generic power curve at 100 m: cut-in 3, rated 12, cut-out 25 m/s, cubic ramp, losses 12%
wind_caveat: Estimate. ~9 km reanalysis winds smooth ridge and pass speed-ups, so wind CF is likely biased low in complex terrain (Tehachapi, Altamont) versus operating plants; validate against WIND Toolkit or EIA-923.

pvwatts.note: PVWatts baseline: single-axis tracker without backtracking; ours backtracks (no row shading). PVWatts uses an NSRDB TMY year; ours is Open-Meteo 2024 actuals. Expect a few CF points of spread.
